about: The Workbench icons of the BlobWars drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's icons/blobwars48x48.png. BlobWars-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BlobWars.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BlobWars.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence; Folder.info for data, gfx, music, sound and doc and their drawers.
